## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] Raw output is included as the tools wrote it.
- [ ] Conditions are recorded: device, chip, memory, OS build, power state and tool versions.
- [ ] Model and data hashes match the PoC's, or the difference is stated.
- [ ] Summaries regenerate from the raw files with the command in the README.
- [ ] Claims are tagged MEASURED, OBSERVED, INFERRED or HYPOTHESIS.
- [ ] Deviations from the PoC's method are listed, or there are none.
- [ ] No personal data, model weights, datasets or copyrighted text.
- [ ] AI assistance is disclosed, or none was used.
